activities.name: Register Parking Entry
activities.meaning: Create an active parking session when a vehicle enters.

activities.name: Close Parking Session
activities.meaning: Record the vehicle exit and close the active session.

activities.name: Calculate Parking Fee
activities.meaning: Calculate the payable amount from the recorded duration.

activities.name: Initiate Payment
activities.meaning: Begin payment for an ended and unpaid session.

activities.name: Confirm Payment
activities.meaning: Complete a valid payment and mark the session as paid.

activities.name: Reject Payment
activities.meaning: Reject a payment attempt on an exceptional simulated path.
